title: Mainz Intracoronary Database. The Coronary Slow-flow and Microvascular Diseases Registry
official: Mainzer IntraCoronAry daTabase (MICAT). Das Coronary Slow Flow- Syndrom Und Koronare Mikrozirkulationsstörungen- Register.
summary: Primary goal of the registry is to collect prospective data on patients undergoing coronary angiography in Mainz. Following amendment of the procol, this study will also include patients who received an Aborb bioresorbable scaffold for the therapy of de novo stenoses.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* clinical indication to coronary angiography

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
